_comment: Curated registry of VERIFIED publishers: publisher.id -> base64 Ed25519 public key. A subscribed manifest is promoted to the 'verified' trust tier only when it is signed AND its publisher key matches the entry here (a validly self-signed feed whose key is NOT here stays 'community' / trust-on-first-use). v1 is hand-curated; add an entry via PR. Keys below the _comment line are real trusted keys.
